category-excludes.json before this change: apply_ids = pistachios, peanuts, almonds, walnuts, mixed-nuts; the 20 other non-drink 'Snacks & Drinks' ids (tortilla-chips, potato-chips, crackers, cheese-crackers, pretzels, microwave-popcorn, cookies, sandwich-cookies, granola-bars, protein-bars, fruit-snacks, toaster-pastries, granola, rice-cakes, beef-jerky, fruit-cups, pudding-cups, gelatin, gingersnaps, corn-chips) fall to the shared ^(Dairy|Bread|Canned|Sauces|Baking|Pasta|Coffee|Frozen|Snacks) block, which carries no beverage class.

commodities.json: protein-bars is index 237, sports-drinks 251 with include 'gatorade'. So a bare 'gatorade' exclude baked into protein-bars sends 'Gatorade Chocolate Chip Protein Bar 2.8 Oz' and its Peanut Butter twin to sports-drinks (plan-2026-09-18.routing.json variant B3). That is the 'gatorade release' the hand-back asked for, and it is also a breach of the library's own rule: a class token belongs there only if it is wrong for EVERY commodity in scope, and protein-bars legitimately owns Gatorade's protein bars.

surface_fix.what: apply_ids reaches the other 20 non-drink Snacks & Drinks commodities, so the bake gives each the 30 beverage tokens and audit-food-category judges a beverage on them
surface_fix.exact_change: category-excludes.json apply_ids[0].ids += the 20 ids above (25 in all); then powershell -File grocery\apply-category-excludes.ps1 bakes the tokens into commodities.json (the bake reported +925 patterns across 188 commodities)

items.root_cause: the food-class guard scopes the beverage class by display bucket, and 'Snacks & Drinks' mixes drinks with 21 non-drink commodities; apply_ids covered pistachios only of those 21, and the one token that stopped the widening (bare 'gatorade') was itself wrong for a commodity in the widened scope

root_fix.what: make the class token say what the class means (a Gatorade DRINK, never Gatorade's protein bar), and give Fruit, Vegetables and Meat the protein-bar reach the bare token used to lend them, so narrowing costs no scope anything
root_fix.exact_change: classes.beverage: 'gatorade' -> 'gatorade(?!.*\bprotein\s+bars?\b)'; classes.snack_carrier += '\bprotein\s+bars?\b'; re-bake. The bake is additive, so every commodity that already carried the bare 'gatorade' keeps it and also gains the narrowed form: their routing cannot change.

items.leaves_open: 241 non-drink commodities in five other display buckets still carry no beverage class (Dairy & Eggs 25, Canned & Soup 59, Sauces & Condiments 61, Baking & Spices 78, Coffee, Oils & Spreads 14), so audit-food-category cannot see a beverage on them; the 30 beverage tokens have not been measured against those buckets' own products, so a widening there needs its own routing measurement per bucket

items.subject: Baker's ad list: brand-only offers of tracked goods are unrouted (e.g. Pepsi, Tide, Doritos, Swanson)
evidence: grocery\pull-bakers-ad-list.ps1 over the FROZEN grocery\regression-inputs\bakers-ad-2026-09-16 (169 offers, Saddlecreek, -Today 2026-09-18), current rules: routed 90, unrouted 79, terms 85 (the dispatch's 90 of 169, reproduced). An offer is routed only when a phrase resolves through match-lib Resolve-Commodity to a commodity that has commodity-search.json terms.

Unrouted brand-only offers whose brand IS one commodity: 'Pepsi' / '7UP' / 'Big K' (12-Pack, 12 fl oz Cans) -> soda ('Soda (12-pack)', includes \bsoda\b, \bcola\b, fridge pack); 'Doritos' (body 'or Ruffles ... or Sunchips') -> tortilla-chips / potato-chips (includes need 'tortilla chip' / 'potato chip' adjacent); 'Dasani Water' (24-Pack, 16.9 fl oz) -> bottled-water ('Bottled Water (24-pack)', includes purified/spring/drinking/bottled water); 'Bigelow Tea' (18-20 ct) -> tea-bags.

Unrouted brand-only offers whose brand is NOT one commodity (left unrouted on purpose): 'Tide Laundry Detergent' (laundry-detergent is labelled 'Laundry Detergent (Arm & Hammer OxiClean)' and every include names Arm & Hammer), 'Swanson Broth' (chicken, beef and vegetable broth are three commodities, and Swanson also sells canned chicken), 'Progresso Soup' (no generic soup commodity; Progresso also sells bread crumbs), 'Kroger Cheese', 'Ken's or Kraft Salad Dressing', four wine offers (red and white are separate commodities).

surface_fix.what: brand words on the commodities each brand genuinely is, with the two fences the first routing pass proved necessary
surface_fix.exact_change: soda.include += '\bpepsi\b', '\b7[\s-]?up\b', '\bbig\s+k\b'; tortilla-chips.include += '\bdoritos\b'; potato-chips.include += '\bruffles\b'; bottled-water.include += '\bdasani\b'; tea-bags.include += '\bbigelow\b'; soda.exclude += '\brebate\b'; tortilla-chips.exclude += '\bpotato\s+(?:snack\s+)?chips?\b'

items.root_cause: the catalogue includes name kinds of product, not brands, so a brand-only offer headline has no include to hit; the matcher correctly does not guess
items.root_fix_none_because: the root cause IS catalogue data and the surface fix is its fix: a brand word belongs in an include only where every product the brand sells is that commodity, a per-brand judgment the matcher cannot make for itself. The router-level alternative (infer the commodity from the store's own catalogue) was measured and rejected in plan-2026-09-18-3: 16 of 79 offers reachable, at least 4 of those wrong.

items.subject: Grocery: buttermilk claims donuts, biscuits, syrup and dressing by a flavour word (found closing 2026-09-18-b1d8e3)
evidence: commodities.json buttermilk (index 165, unit floz): include is the bare word 'buttermilk'; excludes pancake, biscuit, \branch\b, bread, fried, waffle, \bmix\b, powder. So any name carrying the word routes there unless one of those words is also present.

Routing over 42,768 names: 196 names carry 'buttermilk'; 22 route to buttermilk, 14 real (Hiland, Kemps, Kroger cultured buttermilk in pints, quarts and half gallons) and 8 not: Butter Country Rich and Creamy Buttermilk Syrup (4 listings, Walmart), Entenmann's Classic Glazed Buttermilk Donuts (Baker's; Walmart 8 count), Kraft Buttermilk Dressing (Walmart), Pillsbury Grands Southern Homestyle Buttermilk Refrigerated (Walmart 07-18). The ops lane's 8 of 22, reproduced.

Live buttermilk cells on the 15:46:51 board are real buttermilk (Walmart 'Hiland Cultured Low-Fat Buttermilk, Half Gallon' 0.054/floz; Hy-Vee Hiland, Fareway Kemps, Family Fare Kemps, Baker's Kroger), so 0 wrong-product cells today.

surface_fix.what: an identity requirement: buttermilk must be the HEAD NOUN of the name, followed only by a size, a fat level, 'cultured', punctuation, a digit or the end of the name

items.root_cause: buttermilk's include matches the word anywhere in a name, so a flavour or style word routes baked goods, a syrup and a dressing to the dairy commodity when no earlier commodity claims them
items.root_fix_none_because: the identity requirement IS the class fix for this commodity: it refuses every flavour or style use of the word (donuts, syrup, dressing, biscuits, pancakes, pie, chicken...), whatever the product, instead of fencing the four products found; each of the 14 real buttermilk names ends the name or is followed by a size or fat word

open_questions_for_brad.question: laundry-detergent is 'Laundry Detergent (Arm & Hammer OxiClean)' and all five includes name Arm & Hammer, so Baker's 'Tide Laundry Detergent' offer (117-132 fl oz) routes nowhere and no other brand can ever hold that cell.
